title: Crescent Kingdom
description: Crescent Kingdom is the ultimate Fantasy-SMP experience, overhauling Minecraft while remaining a non-modded experience. New crops, gemstones, mushrooms, fishing minigames, accessories, stats, magical spells, 1000+ blocks, 100+ tamable mobs, & so much more!
body:
🌙 **Crescent SMP** 🌌

✅ The most immersive Minecraft experience of all time.

Tired of the same old survival gameplay?

⚙️ Crescent SMP changes everything — Delivering the ultimate fantasy SMP experience!

- ✨ Java & Bedrock Compatibility!

- 🎉 Active Community!

- 💎 Professions Overhaul — Mini-games while fishing, gathering gemstones & mushrooms, new crops and custom enchantment systems!

- 🦞 Hundreds of Custom, Tameable Mobs and Creatures!

- 🌲 Custom Terrain and Dimension Engines!

- 🧱 Over 800 custom blocks, 200+ unique items, armor, weapons, tools, and more!

- 🪄 Over 70 Magical Spells to Cast!

🚪 Ready to see what a redefined Minecraft looks like?

📍 Join now: https://discord.gg/crescentkingdom

🎥 Watch Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U5Uj0IQvAl0

🌙 Crescent SMP – Redefining Custom.
